current.text: Washington added Anthony Davis, Trae Young and AJ Dybantsa. Tre Johnson is not in the projected starting five of Young, Kyshawn George, Dybantsa, Davis and Alex Sarr.
The new arrivals are expected to cut into the roles of Washington's young players.
Washington has a crowded group of wings and guards. The fifth starter spot is open, with many wings competing for it.
Washington is trying to compete now, so the late-season resting and minutes cuts of past years should not happen.
He scored 25 points on 20 shots in his one Summer League game.

durable.text: He is probably the best shooter on the Wizards.
One expert worries that he does nothing besides score.
